title: Space kid channels an Egyptian god inside the pyramid

tellings.quote: And he did experiments with um uh one of the space kids in the pyramid and they brought through this information. Apparently, they're channeling this Egyptian god

plain: In 1976, inside the Great Pyramid at Giza, a researcher named Andrija Puharich ran experiments with one of the young people called 'space kids', who is said to have channelled an Egyptian god and brought through messages. An unnamed guest tells Michels this without naming a source: 'Apparently, they're channeling this Egyptian god.' If true, it would mean a voice claiming to be an ancient god spoke through a living person.
